scope: Replaces all 50 exact slices and all 11 atomic UI controls in place, fills 10 missing 420px symbols and one legacy alias, replaces the badge sheet at its original dimensions.
nine_slice_note: Existing atomic UI_PIECES target dimensions and center xywh values are preserved exactly. Exact slices had no numeric grid metadata; new safe grids are explicitly marked. Search magnifiers keep fixed target height. Round icons, statuses, ornaments and dividers scale uniformly.
client_note: Artwork and metadata only. No unknown client directory was read or modified. Server state meanings and dynamic text belong to the client.
